label: thm:topological-mass
title: Topological Decomposition of Mass
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe (quantum observable universe). Let q denote the substrate parameter. Let \varrho \colon \mathbf{1} \to A be a morphism (a "closed cycle" in A, mass identity) whose categorical support is generated by N consecutive extensions along the brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0} (recursive brane tower), applied to a base-level morphism \varrho_0 \colon \mathbf{1} \to A_0.

The mass \mathfrak{m}(\varrho) (mass identity) admits a decomposition into descended and transient contributions via the descent involution \hat{\tau}_n (descent involution):

\mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  = 
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{desc}}(\varrho)
  \bigr\rVert
  + 
  \sum_{i=1}^{N}
  \bigl\lVert
  \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{trans}}(\varrho, p_i)
  \bigr\rVert,

where:

  1. \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{desc}}(\varrho) evaluates the categorical trace of (\int_A \otimes \mathrm{id}) \circ \Delta \circ \varrho restricted to the descended subalgebra \mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{desc}} = \mathrm{im}\hat{\tau}_n (descent eigenspaces). Since \mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{desc}} \cong \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_n) via the ascent embedding \ell_n, this equals the mass of the base-level cycle \varrho_0. It captures the baseline drag of the Frobenius--Hopf structure along the trivial core.
  2. Each \mathrm{tr}_{\mathrm{trans}}(\varrho, p_i) evaluates the categorical trace restricted to the component of the transient complement \mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{trans}} = \ker\hat{\tau}_n localised at the i-th blow-up centre p_i (brane boundary). The localisation remains well-defined because the kernels of \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} at distinct blow-up centres form disjoint submodules of \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_{n+1}).

The decomposition follows from the idempotent splitting \mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A_{n+1}) = \mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{desc}} \oplus \mathcal{A}^{\mathrm{trans}} (descent eigenspaces) and the linearity of the categorical trace. When the splitting remains orthogonal with respect to the Frobenius norm, \lVert \alpha \rVert^2 = \lVert \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) \rVert^2 + \lVert \alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) \rVert^2, the mass decomposes additively as stated.

For the archimedean realisation---where the descended trace yields the holonomy \mathrm{Hol}_{\nabla_A} and each transient trace yields the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q(z_i)---see archimedean proof.

Archimedean specialisation. The categorical mass \mathrm{categoricalMass} : R \to \mathbb{R} forms the post-\tau archimedean realisation of the generic mass decomposition over a normed ground ring. It constitutes an R\to\mathbb{R} norm evaluation at q_0 and is intrinsically wall-crossing.
